faq.q: How much does Gregg & Associates charge?
faq.a: Gregg & Associates publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Gregg & Associates offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Gregg & Associates publishes a free initial consultation.

faq.q: Where does Gregg & Associates have offices?
faq.a: Gregg & Associates publishes one office, in Staten Island. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Gregg & Associates?
faq.a: Gregg & Associates names two attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. 2 of 2 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status.

faq.a: Gregg & Associates scores 40 and sits at Listed. Passed: licensure, discipline, entity registration and website. Did not pass: footprint.
